mapper.select: select p.product_name as productName, p.spec as spec, p.stock_qty as stockQty, p.purchase_price as purchasePrice, (p.stock_qty * p.purchase_price) as stockCost, ifnull(sum(pu.amount),0) as purchaseCost, ifnull(sum(pu.qty),0) as purchaseQty, case when ifnull(sum(pu.qty),0) = 0 then p.purchase_price else sum(pu.amount)/sum(pu.qty) end as avgPrice from pms_product p left join pms_purchase pu on pu.product_id = p.product_id AND pu.status = '0' AND pu.purchase_time >= #{beginTime} AND pu.purchase_time <= #{endTime} where p.del_flag = '0' AND p.product_name like concat('%', #{productName}, '%') AND p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND p.stock_qty <= 0 AND p.stock_qty > 0 AND p.stock_qty < ifnull(#{warnThreshold},5) AND p.stock_qty >= ifnull(#{warnThreshold},5) group by p.product_id, p.product_name, p.spec, p.stock_qty, p.purchase_price order by stockCost desc

select s.supplier_name as supplierName, count(pu.purchase_id) as purchaseTimes, ifnull(sum(pu.qty),0) as totalQty, ifnull(sum(pu.amount),0) as totalAmount, count(distinct pu.product_id) as productCount from pms_supplier s left join pms_purchase pu on pu.supplier_id = s.supplier_id AND pu.status = '0' AND pu.purchase_time >= #{beginTime} AND pu.purchase_time <= #{endTime} where s.del_flag = '0' AND s.supplier_id = #{supplierId} group by s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name order by totalAmount desc

select (select count(1) from pms_product where del_flag = '0') as productCount, (select count(1) from pms_product where del_flag = '0' and stock_qty > 0 and stock_qty < ifnull(#{warnThreshold},5)) as warnCount, (select count(1) from pms_product where del_flag = '0' and stock_qty <= 0) as emptyCount, (select count(1) from pms_device where online_status = '0' or last_heartbeat is null or last_heartbeat < date_sub(now(), interval 120 second)) as offlineDeviceCount, (select count(1) from pms_logistics where pay_status = '0') as uncheckedCount, (select count(1) from pms_logistics where pay_status in ('0','1')) as unpaidCount, (select ifnull(sum(amount),0) from pms_sale where status = '0' and sale_time >= #{beginTime} and sale_time <= #{endTime}) as todayTurnover from dual
